reuse.why: Threads the flag through the existing getMonthWideBudgetCategories selection helper for setZero/setLastMonthSpending/set*Avg, but copyPreviousMonth keeps its own inline hidden check instead of using that selection.

duplication.why: The hidden-category rule is now toggled in two places (SQL in the helper and the inline condition in copyPreviousMonth), and the same optional-flag arg type is repeated across five action signatures.

placement.why: The selection rule lives in the shared category-selection helper in actions.ts where the other exclusions are, with only copyPreviousMonth patched in place.

scope.why: Only the actions and a focused test extension are touched.

maintainability.why: Simple optional parameter on the shared selector is easy to own, though the second copy of the hidden rule in copyPreviousMonth must be kept in sync.

bypasses_abstraction.where: copyPreviousMonth applies the hidden/group-hidden exclusion inline rather than via getMonthWideBudgetCategories (pre-existing, extended rather than routed)

disguised_duplication.where: The duplicated hidden check in copyPreviousMonth is plainly the same rule, not reshaped
